jurisdiction.gateScope: If Privacy/Legal determines a jurisdiction cannot be supported at launch, restrict Wand Account registration and/or Community writes there as required rather than disabling accountless local Wand functionality globally.
jurisdiction.signedOutPublicRead: Available where lawful; Legal may require jurisdiction-specific restrictions.

localization.rule: Wand launch locale set must match all languages supported by the current supported Disney Dreamlight Valley release; Wand does not intentionally add game-data languages that DDV itself does not support.
firstPartySurfaces: Guide canonical content intended for launch

accessibility.appliesTo: Public Wand web UI and launch-critical authenticated UI
requirements: keyboard-operable core jobs and non-drag alternative for drag operations
semantic labels/names/roles for actionable controls and status/error messaging
AA contrast and readable responsive layout
screen-reader-compatible navigation, forms, dialogs, validation and command-disabled reasons
touch target and pointer alternatives consistent with WCAG 2.2 AA
World Editor must expose non-pointer control paths for launch-critical editing operations rather than requiring drag-only interaction
accessibility.ugcMediaBoundary: Wand must provide accessible surrounding controls/metadata and support descriptive text where applicable; Wand does not claim that every creator-supplied image is intrinsically accessible.
